cited_by.title: Plantain, yam and cassava: blood sugar and safety

record.design: Narrative review of published glycaemic index values of foods in Nigeria
record.finding: Many staples (tuwo, amala, fufu, garri, pounded yam, rice, beans and plantain) were reported as high glycaemic index (75 to 97). Less common foods such as maize pudding, moi-moi, fonio and dambu showed lower values (14 to 53). The authors say the lower-index foods may need certification before people with diabetes rely on them.
record.note: A non-systematic overview; it conflicts with Oladele 2016 on plantain, so values depend on variety, ripeness and cooking.
